title: The 3-email cart recovery sequence (1 prompt)
caption: Your abandoned cart email says 'you forgot something.' Here's the 3-email sequence that gives them a reason to come back, plus the prompt that writes it. #emailmarketing #abandonedcart #shopifytips #aitools

beats.headline: They *almost* bought.
beats.say: Someone *added* your product to cart, and left. And your email says, you forgot something. [laughter]

beats.headline: Bring them *back*
beats.say: Here's a three-email sequence that actually brings them *back.* And one prompt writes all of it.
beats.box: one prompt writes all of it.

beats.headline: Reminders don't *sell.*
beats.say: [sigh] You forgot something is not a reason to *buy.*

beats.headline: The last one | closes the *sale.*
beats.say: Three emails. The last one closes the *sale.*
Email one, an hour later. Don't just remind them. Show the *product*, one real review, and a *single* button back to the cart.
Email two, the next day. *Answer* the reason they left. Too pricey? Show the value. Not sure about size? Link the guide. Worried about shipping? Give the exact date.
Email three, two days later. Now give a *small* push. Ten percent off or free shipping, with a real deadline. Never in email one, or they'll learn to wait.

visual.prompt: Write a 3-email cart recovery sequence for [product]. Voice: [brand voice]. Objection: [objection]. Add subject lines.

beats.say: Here's the prompt. *Paste* in your product, your brand voice, and your biggest objection. Ask for three emails with subject lines. Done in thirty seconds.
Bonus. Write subject lines like a text from a friend. *Lowercase*, short, no shouting. Still want it?

beats.headline: Set it *once.*
beats.say: Set it up *once.* It works every single day.

beats.label: Steal the sequence
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, set it up tonight, and follow for more.
